info.title: Payvand API
info.description:
Accounts, Solana payment invoices, shops, discounts and admin oversight for Payvand.

Every route below lives on the API origin. Routes marked with a session need `Authorization: Bearer <token>` from `/api/auth/signin` or `/api/auth/signup`. Admin routes additionally require the signed-in account's email to be listed in `ADMIN_EMAILS`.
